text:
lee: follow-up from the morning postmortem: we had an alert avalanche from the quota-checker job. Rough numbers: ~95 pages in 8m, ~70% duplicates. We need a small, concrete remediation plan (owners + dates).

maria: I pulled the traces. root causes: aggressive retries in the job, alert threshold tuned for single-instance flakiness, and no ingestion dedupe.

ash: quick actionable list (i'll take #2):
1) quota-checker alert threshold change: bump from 2 -> 10 failures per 10m. owner: lee. due: 2025-02-05. ticket: SINF-501.
2) add dedupe at ingestion layer: collapse identical fingerprints within 3m, include count and unique host list. owner: ash. due: 2025-02-03.
3) Alertmanager grouping tweak: group_by ['alertname','service'], group_interval 4m. owner: maria. due: 2025-02-02.
4) scheduled-job silence defaults: add opt-in silence rules for noisy cron jobs. owner: sara. due: 2025-02-01.

sara: i'll draft the ops-config PR for silence defaults. need confirmation of cron for quota-checker (is it `*/5 * * * *`?).

maria: yes cron is every 5m. for cron silences we'll do +/-1m window. also suggest a small retry jitter in the job to avoid synchronized retries.

lee: decision: prefer collapse+count instead of outright drop. keep brief summary in the alert body.

ops-bot: created SINF-501 - "quota-checker noisy pages" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-501

ash: i'll add unit tests to the ingestion pipeline to verify dedupe window behavior.

sara: ops-config PR planned for today; will link ticket.

maria: i'll add a dashboard tile for "duplicate alert ratio" so we can watch impact for the next week.

lee: thanks team. i'll move these into the postmortem follow-up tracker and kick off a 10m check-in on Thursday to confirm progress. If anyone needs to swap owners or dates, reply here.
